words.text: Met Lia for coffee and we ended up talking about the move for two hours. I keep saying I want a smaller life and then filling every evening. Walked home the long way. The city was quiet for once. Then I sat on the steps for a while and did nothing, which felt like the point. Work was fine. Nobody asked for anything I could not give. Tomorrow I want to call Mum before it gets late.

cjkWords.text: 今日は、静かな一日でした。OK だった。
